jobs.title: Director, Product Line Management, Women’s Sneakers & Sport Footwear
jobs.description:
The Director, Product Management, Women’s Sneakers & Sport Footwear is a consumer-focused category leader responsible for shaping and executing the strategic vision for women’s sneaker and sport footwear. This role will lead strategic line planning and end-to-end product lifecycle management across the categories, translating consumer insights, marketplace trends, brand strategy, and commercial opportunities into compelling global assortments that achieve and exceed company revenue and category performance objectives. The Director will partner closely with Design, Product Development, Planning, Sales, Marketing, and regional teams, with direction from the Vice President Product Merchandising.

Core Accountabilities

Lead the women’s sneaker and sport footwear business globally, developing category strategies and seasonal product assortments that align with consumer needs, brand objectives, regional requirements, and financial targets.
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, leveraging consumer insights, business performance, market trends, and productivity metrics to drive product introductions, carryovers, investments, optimizations, and exits.
Create and manage seasonal line plans, assortment architecture, and pricing strategies, ensuring balanced product collections that meet revenue, margin, and IMU objectives.
Provide category leadership throughout the product creation process, influencing key decisions from concept through commercialization and serving as a product voice during reviews, line presentations, and milestone meetings.
Partner cross-functionally with Design, Product Development, Costing, Planning, Sales, Marketing, Buying, and Channel teams to deliver aligned product strategies, accurate product information, and successful seasonal launches.
Represent the category internally and externally, developing selling tools, leading sales meeting presentations, supporting wholesale customer engagements, and communicating product opportunities across global markets.
Identify consumer, marketplace, and competitive opportunities to strengthen the product line, uncover white-space opportunities, and drive continuous improvement in both product performance and business processes.
Lead key operational initiatives including MOQ management, assortment optimization, and process improvement efforts that increase organizational efficiency and executional excellence.
Serve as the primary category expert and business partner for product-related questions, special projects, and strategic initiatives that support the growth of the Women’s footwear business.

Minimum of 8+ years previous related experience in Merchandising or Product Management in Women's sneaker and sport lifestyle footwear

jobs.title: Director, CMC Product Development – Biologics
jobs.description:
About Beeline Medicines

Beeline Medicines is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company focused on developing and delivering category-leading precision therapies to transform the lives of people living with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. With a portfolio of potential best-in-class and first-in-disease therapeutic candidates that directly target key pathways governing dysregulated immunological and inflammatory responses, the Company is developing medicines that have the opportunity to provide durable, life-changing impact. Led by an established executive team and backed by world-class life science investors, each day Beeline Medicines is determined to bring the scientific rigor and operational excellence to get to what matters for patients – realizing a world where people with immune-mediated diseases can live life fully.

Job Summary

The Director, CMC Product Development – Biologics is a senior technical and operational leader responsible for the end-to-end CMC development of biologics drug product candidates, from early formulation through process development, clinical supply, and regulatory submission. Reporting to the Executive Director, CMC Product Development, this individual drives the drug product development strategy for large molecule programs including monoclonal antibodies, fusion proteins, and other biologic modalities. This role works cross-functionally with Analytical Development, Drug Substance Process Development, Quality, Clinical Operations, and external CDMOs to ensure integrated, timeline-aligned delivery of all biologics drug product CMC activities.

Work Arrangement & Location:

Remote -
This position is designated as remote; the incumbent will be expected to travel to Beeline Medicines’ offices on a periodic basis to support in-person collaboration, team engagement, and business operations. The frequency and scheduling of such visits will be determined at the company's discretion based on business need.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Define and execute the biologics drug product development strategy, encompassing formulation development, fill-finish process development, primary container-closure selection, and device development where applicable.
Lead formulation development activities for protein-based therapeutics, including excipient screening, formulation optimization, forced degradation, and compatibility studies.
Oversee drug product process development and scale-up, including fill-finish requirements, technology transfer to CDMO partners, process characterization, and validation readiness.
Author and review biologics drug product sections of regulatory submissions (IND, BLA, Type A/B meeting packages) and lead or support FDA/EMA interactions on drug product CMC topics.
Select and technically govern CDMO partners responsible for biologics drug product manufacture, including clinical supply chain coordination, change control oversight, and deviation management.
Collaborate with Analytical Development to define drug product release and stability specifications, in-process controls, and comparability strategies for process and formulation changes.
Partner with Clinical Operations and Supply Chain to ensure uninterrupted clinical supply across Phase 1–3 trials, including labeling, packaging, and cold chain logistics planning.
Integrate Quality by Design (QbD) principles, Design of Experiments (DoE), and risk management tools into biologics drug product development decisions.
Evaluate novel drug delivery technologies, and device requirements as applicable to the biologics pipeline, including prefilled syringe and autoinjector platforms.
Contribute to CMC due diligence assessments and portfolio planning by evaluating the manufacturability and development feasibility of biologic drug product candidates.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Education: Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
10+ years of CMC biologics experience with demonstrated expertise in drug product formulation and/or fill-finish process development in pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industry
Deep technical expertise in biologics formulation science, including protein stability, aggregation mitigation, excipient selection, lyophilization cycle development, and container-closure systems.
Comprehensive knowledge of ICH Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11, relevant biologics CMC guidelines (Q5A–Q5E), and FDA/EMA drug product development expectations; experience authoring BLA drug product sections.
Proven experience managing biologics drug product CDMO relationships, including technical oversight of fill-finish operations, process scale-up, process qualification, and commercial readiness.
Experience with lyophilized and liquid formulation development for parenteral biologics, including primary packaging compatibility and extractables/leachable considerations.
Working knowledge of biologics drug substance processes (upstream/downstream) sufficient to effectively partner with Drug Substance teams on interface activities and integrated CMC planning.
Proven track record of operating effectively in pre-commercial, resource-constrained environments — balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution and infrastructure building.
Experience managing cross-functional stakeholder relationships at the senior level, with the ability to influence without authority and align diverse teams around shared program goals.
Exceptional ability to translate complex CMC biologics science into clear, decision-ready narratives for executive leadership, cross-functional partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of authoring high-quality regulatory documents, scientific reports, and executive-level presentations.
Collaborative communication style with the ability to establish trust quickly across Research, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and external partners in a matrixed organization.

A discretionary annual bonus and long-term incentive award (e.g., equity) may be available based on individual and Company performance.

This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners.

You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering.

Strategy & Vision

Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product
Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making
Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through
Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale

Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution

Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders

8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process
Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different
Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations
Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production

Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy
A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast

Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work
Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model
Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions
Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design

Our Home & Outdoor
division is united by thoughtful design and lasting quality. From kitchens to campsites, we provide consumers with premium, innovative products for life -- in and out of the home. This business unit includes our OXO, Osprey, and Hydro Flask brands, and this role may support one or more of these brands.

Look around your home, and you'll find us everywhere,
in your kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bathroom. We are already making your everyday lives better. We are powered by knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and forward-thinking people committed to developing a culture of inclusion. Whether you are just starting your career or in need of a challenge, we recognize, develop, and empower talent!

Position:
Senior Product Manager, OXO

Department:
Product Development

Work Location:
New York, NY Hybrid (work 3 days onsite)

Hybrid Schedule:
At Helen of Troy, we embrace a flexible hybrid work model designed to support collaboration and productivity. For roles eligible for hybrid work, our standard schedule includes in-office collaboration from Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays. Any updates to this model will be communicated in advance. Please note that hybrid eligibility and schedules may vary based on business needs and manager expectations.

What You Will Be Doing

The Senior Product Manager will be an authority within OXO product development and on the electric kitchen appliances. You will independently plan and drive a major sub-category of this business and develop a product strategy to ensure financial goals are met.

You are, or you will become, a specialist in the category and have an in-depth understanding of consumer behavior in the space. You will also have complete knowledge of competitor products, pricing and features. By using market research, product research, product testing, pricing and competitive analysis you will develop a strategic vision for the category. You will identify new product opportunities that are compelling to customers and consumers and on brand, building out a product development pipeline that will contribute to team revenue, and positively impact on the company's overall financial goals.

This person will work closely with Product Engineers to identify and avoid product development risks and ensure that products in the pipeline are brought to market on schedule, meeting all landmark goals and are completed within budget. When changes occur, you will communicate schedule, quality and cost updates to partners and clearly communicate remaining risks.

You'll collaborate across all levels of marketing, brand design and sales about product features and benefits to help facilitate effective messaging and with the sourcing, operations and logistics teams to efficiently bring products to market. You will be able to sell your products to internal partners as well as external buyers and vendors. You will lead and mentor the team and provide insight and guidance into category strategy, resulting in tools that make everyday living better for millions of people.

Strategic business planning for a major category of business including meeting financial goals (revenue and margin) and day to day category management.
Planning a product pipeline, seeing opportunities and executing a long- and short-term strategic vision.
Project managing products in your pipeline to deliver products on time and quality.
Cross-functionally build consensus around long and short-term product development strategies.
Building positive relationships with key vendors, strategic customers and industry partners.
Product Line Maintenance, responding to quality concerns, participating in cost negotiations and identifying and implementing product refreshes.
Participate in companywide initiatives to improve processes, functions, communications, and company culture.

Skills Needed To Be Successful In This Role

Strong analysis ability relating to product lines and product line planning, profit margins, business trends, market segmentation, market research, and opportunity assessment.
Hands-on research, product evaluation, testing, and user-validation skills.
Strong project management and people leadership.
Able to lead and influence resources.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Self-motivated, able to prioritize and meet project timelines.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree.
6+ years of prior experience in product development.
Consumer Electrics industry knowledge.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
Knowledge of Agile, Basecamp or other project management software.
Authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with electric kitchen appliances.

Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to location, experience, skill level, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees.

new_jobs.description:
About Beeline Medicines

Beeline Medicines is a clinical‑stage biotechnology company focused on developing and delivering category-leading precision therapies to transform the lives of people living with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. With a portfolio of potential best-in-class and first-in-disease therapeutic candidates that directly target key pathways governing dysregulated immunological and inflammatory responses, the Company is developing medicines that have the opportunity to provide durable, life-changing impact. Led by an established executive team and backed by world-class life science investors, each day Beeline Medicines is determined to bring the scientific rigor and operational excellence to get to what matters for patients – realizing a world where people with immune-mediated diseases can live life fully.

Job Summary

The Director, CMC Product Development – Biologics is a senior technical and operational leader responsible for the end-to-end CMC development of biologics drug product candidates, from early formulation through process development, clinical supply, and regulatory submission. Reporting to the Executive Director, CMC Product Development, this individual drives the drug product development strategy for large molecule programs including monoclonal antibodies, fusion proteins, and other biologic modalities. This role works cross-functionally with Analytical Development, Drug Substance Process Development, Quality, Clinical Operations, and external CDMOs to ensure integrated, timeline-aligned delivery of all biologics drug product CMC activities.

Work Arrangement & Location:

Remote -
This position is designated as remote; the incumbent will be expected to travel to Beeline Medicines’ offices on a periodic basis to support in-person collaboration, team engagement, and business operations. The frequency and scheduling of such visits will be determined at the company's discretion based on business need.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Define and execute the biologics drug product development strategy, encompassing formulation development, fill-finish process development, primary container-closure selection, and device development where applicable.
Lead formulation development activities for protein-based therapeutics, including excipient screening, formulation optimization, forced degradation, and compatibility studies.
Oversee drug product process development and scale-up, including fill-finish requirements, technology transfer to CDMO partners, process characterization, and validation readiness.
Author and review biologics drug product sections of regulatory submissions (IND, BLA, Type A/B meeting packages) and lead or support FDA/EMA interactions on drug product CMC topics.
Select and technically govern CDMO partners responsible for biologics drug product manufacture, including clinical supply chain coordination, change control oversight, and deviation management.
Collaborate with Analytical Development to define drug product release and stability specifications, in-process controls, and comparability strategies for process and formulation changes.
Partner with Clinical Operations and Supply Chain to ensure uninterrupted clinical supply across Phase 1–3 trials, including labeling, packaging, and cold chain logistics planning.
Integrate Quality by Design (QbD) principles, Design of Experiments (DoE), and risk management tools into biologics drug product development decisions.
Evaluate novel drug delivery technologies, and device requirements as applicable to the biologics pipeline, including prefilled syringe and autoinjector platforms.
Contribute to CMC due diligence assessments and portfolio planning by evaluating the manufacturability and development feasibility of biologic drug product candidates.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Qualifications

Education: Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related discipline; or equivalent work experience.
10+ years of CMC biologics experience with demonstrated expertise in drug product formulation and/or fill-finish process development in pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology industry
Deep technical expertise in biologics formulation science, including protein stability, aggregation mitigation, excipient selection, lyophilization cycle development, and container-closure systems.
Comprehensive knowledge of ICH Q8/Q9/Q10/Q11, relevant biologics CMC guidelines (Q5A–Q5E), and FDA/EMA drug product development expectations; experience authoring BLA drug product sections.
Proven experience managing biologics drug product CDMO relationships, including technical oversight of fill-finish operations, process scale-up, process qualification, and commercial readiness.
Experience with lyophilized and liquid formulation development for parenteral biologics, including primary packaging compatibility and extractables/leachable considerations.
Working knowledge of biologics drug substance processes (upstream/downstream) sufficient to effectively partner with Drug Substance teams on interface activities and integrated CMC planning.
Proven track record of operating effectively in pre-commercial, resource-constrained environments — balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution and infrastructure building.
Experience managing cross-functional stakeholder relationships at the senior level, with the ability to influence without authority and align diverse teams around shared program goals.
Exceptional ability to translate complex CMC biologics science into clear, decision-ready narratives for executive leadership, cross-functional partners, and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of authoring high-quality regulatory documents, scientific reports, and executive-level presentations.
Collaborative communication style with the ability to establish trust quickly across Research, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and external partners in a matrixed organization.

Salary Range

Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, location, and other job-related factors permitted by applicable local law. A discretionary annual bonus and long-term incentive award (e.g., equity) may be available based on individual and Company performance.

$199,000 - $258,000 USD

Competitive health and wellness coverage (structure and premiums vary by country)

Job Title:
Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience

Location:
Remote, USA

About The Company

Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com.

About The Role

As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience
at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners.

You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering.

What You'll Do (Job Duties/Responsibilities)

Strategy & Vision

Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product
Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making
Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through
Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale

Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution

Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur
Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations
Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data
Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration

Cross-Functional Leadership

Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders
Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike
Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers

Who You Are (Job Qualifications)

8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process
Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different
Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations
Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production
Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well
Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy
A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast

Skills & Competencies

Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work
Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model
Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions
Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design
Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction
Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric
High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment

new_jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are seeking a Healthcare Solutions Architect to join our Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) Go to Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you will help shape and deliver on our GTM strategy for global healthcare customers and partners. As a solutions architect, you will be at the forefront of helping customers succeed using AWS technologies, linking technology with measurable business value for healthcare and life sciences organizations.

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions.

In this role, you will work closely with Business Development, Sales Specialists, and Product leadership to develop, accelerate, and sell current and new healthcare products. You will engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, design and propose technical solutions, and guide successful implementation. By establishing and growing business and technical relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, you will drive customer adoption and value realization of AWS solutions in the healthcare and life sciences industry. You will use this knowledge to work with the Product organization to develop new features and capabilities and influence the product roadmap.

Key job responsibilities

Work with Business Development (BD) and Sales leaders to lead technical engagement with customers to understand requirements, propose solutions, and address technical concerns
Build and deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs of concept to showcase AWS capabilities to Healthcare customers
Partner with Sales, Business Development, and Marketing teams to develop and execute go-to-market strategies for healthcare solutions
Collaborate with Product teams to develop new features, products, and services that delight healthcare customers, providing technical expertise and customer feedback
Capture and share best practices and technical knowledge within the AWS solutions architect community
Develop customer-facing technical content such as reference architectures, whitepapers, and implementation guides for healthcare use cases
Stay current on industry trends, regulations, and emerging technologies in the healthcare and life sciences space
Travel ~30% of the time to support customer engagements

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

12+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
Experience developing technology solutions and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing
Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences and at C-level, including training, workshops, publications

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of large scale automation and workflow management or equivalent
Knowledge of distributed systems design and implementation or equivalent
Knowledge of database design and implementation or equivalent
Knowledge of presentations and whiteboarding skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with internal and external executives, IT management, and developers
Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
